technique_name: What are the main benefits of eating a vegan diet?
description: The main benefits of eating a vegan diet include improved health, weight loss, protection from diseases, reduced impact on the environment, and saved animal lives. Eating vegan eliminates all animal-based products, meaning that vegans are less prone to many diseases, such as certain types of cancer, diabetes, and hypertension.
